name: Main commits report
ownerWords: how many commits landed on sieun-pi main in the last 4 days, and which component got the most of them? then find the 10 biggest commits and what each one changed, and keep a report with that list updated. i want all 10 explained by tonight
goal: The top-10 report of the last 4 days of sieun-pi main commits stays current: it explains all 10 biggest commits and covers origin/main to within a day, refreshed daily (c66).

metrics.label: Commits explained on the report page (What each commit changed sections)
Hours from the report's newest covered main commit to the newest commit on origin/main

onMiss: Steer the live "main commits report" job by message with `node --import tsx scripts/job-steer.ts 01a14c54-2762-7381-82d0-a8a4ea4aafe6 "main commits report" <message>` from components/user-history, naming the missed metric, its value and target. If no such job is live (agent_observe.list_agents), start one with await rlm.create_session(brief, name="main commits report") with the owner's words first, and set it as the job of the p1 step. The job re-counts the last 4 days of sieun-pi origin/main commits per component, re-picks the 10 biggest, and writes or updates the explanation of each one on the report page. Never start a second copy. Nothing goes outside (c37). With all metrics on target, end the turn with no message.
